clc.name: Nanolite CLC Blocks®
clc.description: Nanolite CLC Blocks are premium lightweight aerated concrete blocks engineered to deliver exceptional structural performance while reducing the overall weight of a building. Manufactured using advanced Cellular Lightweight Concrete (CLC) technology, these blocks provide excellent thermal insulation, sound insulation, fire resistance, and dimensional accuracy, making them an ideal alternative to conventional clay bricks and concrete masonry units.
clc.subtitle: Cellular lightweight concrete for modern masonry

details.title: Available Sizes
list: Custom dimensions are available upon request

details.title: Storage & Handling
details.text: Store Nanolite CLC Blocks on a clean, level surface and protect them from excessive moisture before installation. Blocks should remain securely stacked on pallets and handled carefully during loading, unloading, and transportation to prevent edge damage. Proper storage helps maintain their dimensional accuracy and installation quality until they are ready for use.

details.title: Packaging & Delivery
details.text: Nanolite CLC Blocks are available for individual purchases, palletized orders, full truckloads, and export container shipments. Every order is securely packaged to minimize transportation damage and ensure safe delivery to construction sites. Delivery schedules are coordinated according to project requirements and order quantities.

panels.name: Nanolite Precast Panels
panels.description: Nanolite Precast Panels (PCP) are advanced lightweight concrete wall panels engineered to deliver faster construction, superior thermal insulation, and long-term durability. Manufactured using Nanolite Cellular Lightweight Concrete (CLC) technology, these precision-cast panels provide a modern alternative to conventional masonry and cast-in-place concrete, reducing construction time while maintaining exceptional performance.
panels.subtitle: Factory-made lightweight wall panels

details.title: Available Options
list: Custom dimensions are available upon request

details.title: Storage & Handling
details.text: Precast panels should be stored on a flat, stable surface using appropriate supports to prevent bending or damage. Panels should be lifted using approved lifting points and handled carefully during transportation and installation. Proper storage and handling help maintain dimensional accuracy and surface quality before installation.

details.title: Packaging & Delivery
details.text: Nanolite Precast Panels are securely packaged for safe transportation to construction sites. Depending on project requirements, panels are supplied individually, palletized, or loaded directly onto trucks or shipping containers for domestic and international delivery. Delivery schedules are coordinated to match project timelines and installation sequences.

tiles.name: Nanolite Insulated Roof Tiles
tiles.description: Nanolite Insulated Roof Tiles are advanced lightweight roofing solutions designed to improve thermal efficiency while reducing the structural load on buildings. Manufactured using Nanolite Cellular Lightweight Concrete (CLC) technology, these roof tiles help maintain comfortable indoor temperatures, reduce heat transfer, and contribute to lower energy consumption throughout the year.
tiles.subtitle: Lightweight roofing and thermal insulation

details.title: Available Options
list: Custom dimensions are available upon request

details.title: Storage & Handling
details.text: Roof tiles should be stored on a clean, level surface and protected from impact during transportation and handling. Stacking should follow recommended guidelines to prevent edge damage before installation. Proper storage helps preserve product quality and ensures safe installation on-site.

details.title: Supply & Delivery
details.text: Nanolite Insulated Roof Tiles are available for individual projects, bulk commercial orders, and export shipments. Products are securely packaged and prepared for safe transportation, with scheduled deliveries available to meet project timelines and construction requirements.

hybrid.name: Nano Hybrid Wall System
hybrid.description: Nanolite Hybrid Walls® are an innovative wall construction system designed to simplify modern building while improving structural efficiency, thermal insulation, and construction speed. The system consists of specially designed wall formwork that is filled with Nanolite Cellular Lightweight Concrete (CLC), creating a solid, lightweight, and highly insulated wall with a smooth finished surface.
hybrid.subtitle: An insulated wall construction system

details.title: Available Options
list: Custom dimensions are available upon request

details.title: Project Supply & Installation
details.text: Nanolite Hybrid Walls are supplied as a complete construction system, including technical guidance for installation and CLC pouring. Depending on project requirements, our team can provide material supply, engineering consultation, and installation support to help ensure efficient project execution and consistent construction quality.

details.title: Why Choose Nanolite Hybrid Walls?
details.text: Nanolite Hybrid Walls provide a faster, cleaner, and more efficient alternative to conventional brick masonry. By combining lightweight concrete with an innovative wall system, they reduce structural dead loads, improve thermal and acoustic insulation, minimize construction time, and deliver a smooth finished surface that requires little to no plaster, helping reduce both labor and finishing costs.

permeable.name: Nanolite Permeable Concrete®
permeable.description: Nanolite Porous Concrete is an advanced permeable concrete system designed to allow water to pass naturally through its surface, reducing runoff and promoting groundwater recharge. Engineered for modern infrastructure, it provides an effective drainage solution while maintaining the durability and reliability required for residential, commercial, and public developments.
permeable.subtitle: A surface designed to let water pass through

details.title: Available Options
list: Custom dimensions are available upon request

details.title: Storage & Handling
details.text: All raw materials should be stored in a clean and dry environment prior to production. During installation, the concrete should be placed and cured in accordance with recommended construction practices to ensure optimum permeability, durability, and long-term performance.

details.title: Supply & Delivery
details.text: Nanolite supplies Porous Concrete for projects ranging from residential driveways to large commercial and infrastructure developments. Flexible delivery options, scheduled dispatches, and project-based supply plans are available to meet your construction timeline.

readymix.name: Nano ReadyMix®
readymix.description: Designed for consistent performance and professional-grade CLC production, Nano ReadyMix® is Nanolite's proprietary dry mix engineered for manufacturers, contractors, and construction professionals. Every bag is formulated to simplify production while delivering reliable density, improved workability, and outstanding strength.
readymix.subtitle: Premium dry mix for cellular lightweight concrete

details.title: Compliance & Quality
details.text: Nano ReadyMix® is manufactured under strict internal quality control procedures to ensure consistent performance and reliable production. Every batch is carefully inspected before packaging to maintain high manufacturing standards.

details.title: Storage & Shelf Life
details.text: Store bags in a cool, dry environment away from moisture and direct sunlight. Keep packaging sealed until use and store on pallets for maximum protection. When stored correctly, Nano ReadyMix® maintains its quality throughout its recommended shelf life.

agent.name: Nanolite Ready Foaming Agent®
agent.description: Nanolite Ready Foaming Agent is a premium foaming solution specifically engineered for the production of high-quality Cellular Lightweight Concrete (CLC). Developed to produce stable, uniform, and long-lasting foam, it ensures consistent density, improved workability, and reliable performance throughout the manufacturing process.
agent.subtitle: A foaming solution for cellular lightweight concrete

details.title: Storage & Shelf Life
details.text: Nanolite Ready Foaming Agent in its original sealed container in a cool, dry, and well-ventilated area away from direct sunlight, excessive heat, and freezing conditions. Keep the container tightly closed when not in use to prevent contamination. When stored under recommended conditions, the product maintains its quality and performance throughout its specified shelf life. Always follow Nanolite's storage and handling recommendations to ensure optimum product performance.

t500.name: T-500 Plant
t500.description: The T-500 Plant uses manual production for cellular lightweight concrete, with a nominal output of 500 blocks per day. The configuration combines slurry and foam mixing with block moulds, without a cutting machine or bulk silos.
t500.subtitle: Start your production journey

details.title: Production capacity
details.text: Nominal output: 500 blocks per day. Actual output depends on block dimensions, mix design, shift length, mould availability, curing and handling. Confirm the operating specification with our team.

details.title: Mixing & foam control
details.text: The hollow-bore shaft spiral mixer is designed to distribute pre-generated foam through the slurry with controlled mixing, helping preserve the cellular structure. Mix design, dosing, mixing time and quality checks are established during commissioning.

details.title: Operation
details.text: Manual production configuration. Site layout, utilities and staffing are planned around the agreed equipment specification.

details.title: Installation & commissioning
details.text: Discuss site layout, utilities, installation, trial batches, operator training and the scope of ongoing assistance in your project proposal.

details.title: Plan your facility
details.text: Share your location, factory area, target products, utility availability and intended start date. Our team will prepare an equipment and production-layout proposal.

pouring.name: Nanolite CLC Pouring
pouring.description: Nanolite CLC Pouring is a specialized on-site concrete placement service designed for projects requiring lightweight, thermally efficient, and precisely controlled Cellular Lightweight Concrete (CLC). Using Nano ReadyMix®, Nanolite Ready Foaming Agent, and advanced mixing equipment, our experienced team produces fresh CLC directly on-site and pumps it into the required area with speed and accuracy.
pouring.subtitle: On-site lightweight concrete placement

details.title: Available Options
list: Custom dimensions are available upon request

details.title: Site Requirements
details.text: Before pouring begins, the work area should be prepared and accessible for equipment and material delivery. Utilities, formwork, and project specifications should be finalized to ensure an efficient pouring process. Our team will coordinate with your site engineers to achieve the required density, volume, and placement quality.

details.title: Project Planning & Delivery
details.text: Nanolite provides complete project planning, scheduling, material supply, and on-site technical support for CLC pouring services. From small residential applications to large commercial and infrastructure developments, every project is planned to meet your construction schedule and engineering requirements.
